bestBets.overview: Warm days, heavy morning dews, unless they overdo the irrigation expect an upgrade to good for this midweek Ipswich fixture. Eight races to unfold. Kick things off with a 1200m Maiden Plate. Four of the remaining ten will be 1st-up from a spell, two will be on debut (interestingly both from the Vandyke yard). No's 1,2,10 looks to be the pace. Bit going on here, not at all easy lining them up. Resuming new blood via FARSET, now with Jack Bruce, the current 'King of the rejects' up this way. No public trials. RUM AND KIRK mapped a treat, ain't running. Then there's the resuming SPEEDY CROWN in the astute Lockwood/Vincent stable, albeit the alley concerns. No public trials. VEOMAS had no favours 2nd-up, was drawn to have no favours here.  Perhaps the alley triggered its early scratching? YOTEI caught the eye 1st-up.

raceTips.comment: We race at Ipswich on Wednesday under fine skies & warm temperatures, expect a good track. Tricky race to kick off the day as I have 3 runners I'm personally keen to follow off recent efforts (2, 7 & 11). However, right down the bottom Yotei is the way I'm leaning, out of the money both starts the latest was in Saturday grade & he strips fitter for the solid finishing effort when well in the market. I'll throw the other trio into the top 4 & will scream should one of them win!

bestBets.overview: 1200m Maiden Plate. A dozen can run but won't. As things stand three (not four) still resume, now two (not four) debut (Heathcote had three engaged, now just one). From a punt perspective this was always  a higher risk play than would usually be the case, little has changed. The map suggests no's 2 & 3 can get a suitable time of it up on the pace. They met when resuming at Eagle Farm, finishing 4th and 7th respectively. Neither had any excuse, of course both should be stripping fitter here just the same. Bookies love the resuming OREGON COAST. Let's see what the mounting yard judges make of that.

raceTips.comment: David Vandyke trained Oregon Coast appeals here resuming from a break. She's only had the two career starts to date running into the well above average Chilly Girl on debut beaten 4.6L in Group 3 company before beating all bar the very smart Pembrey at Eagle Farm back in February. Trialled well & looks ready to go from an inside draw for leading jockey Ben Thompson. Stevie's Spirit is in very good hands & won both lead up trials, keeping very safe.

bestBets.overview: 1100m BM65. No's 2 & 5 look to be the speed. Perhaps the 3 settles closest to them. CERTIFIED COPY has resumed in good form, 1st and 2nd over 1200m, was my pick, is now out. JIMMYINTHEJUNGLE is on trial beyond 1000m, no knock until they fail and the claim will help Jim 'stay' the distance. The scratching of the toppy helps.  MISHANI EXTREME in the mix but drawn to need some luck early. WHISPERING ROGUE maps well. The lack of a rider made me think Desleigh Forster is delaying the inevitable with MEET GEORGE, and so it eventually proved to be. VIN SANTO won well when resuming and also having first start for Renita Beaton. My concern is may well need the sting out to run to its best. Of course, could be that Renita has made all the difference.

raceTips.comment: Taking a punt here tipping Mishani Extreme who doesn't fare well at the barriers & yes will need a touch of luck. He's been going along well of late though & does race well on this track having won 2 of his 3 starts with the only defeat coming at his latest run when game after sitting deep without cover. Fireforce was solid first up for the new yard, second up record is solid missing a place only once in 4 attempts which includes a win.

bestBets.overview: 2000m BM65. Waller is good for four, that's 33% of the field, not ideal, not ideal at all.  No's 1 & 8 map to set the pace, race run to suit. POWER PACK won well here latest, maps very well but rises 2kg's, that's the worry. POSSIBILITIES has resumed with two decent efforts, can have the fresher legs when things get willing. The stablemate WOUNDER has settled in beautifully to the SE Qld way of life. Connections must be thrilled to see a cheque in the mail rather than a bill. Was soundly beaten by a handy one last start. The stablemate EMPIRE OF ART hasn't had a fair go latest two, strips fitter for them and gets the numero uno hoop.

raceTips.comment: There's a few here who don't win out of turn & Super Fair fits that category perfectly however if a decent price could well be worth an each-way ticket here. All runs bar one (two back) have been quite good this prep & there were valid issues at the poor one when eased down. Trip suits & will carry less weight after the claim. Possibilities is very consistent & should be ready to win third run back, definite threat as in Wounder however not both not proven out to this longer trip.

bestBets.overview: 1200m C5. No's 2,6,7 map to make the pace, race run to suit. This will be the easiest race ADDRIEL has contested since winning this track and distance over two years ago. And it was in this very class, lumping 55 that day. Strips fitter for the 1st-up 4th at Doomben when off an 80 weeks absence. Will also be the easiest race GOSPEL GIRL has contested since placing here over 1350m in a BM65 some 21 months ago. She strips fitter for the 1st-up 3rd to the very much in-form Grinzinger Champ. Takes a claim for the very much in-form Bella Youngberry.  Respect the betting with it given the resuming stablemate EXCEED SPEED draws well for R Maloney and has run well fresh previously. Market will be a wonderful guide as to what Gollan expects. KINGDOM UNDERSIEGE strips fitter for a close up 4th in town where traffic did its thing and posed a problem. Hopefully the plan is to be positive from that alley. You just never know until them gates fly.

raceTips.comment: Second run back from a break Gospel Girl looks very well placed. Not far from Grinzinger Champ which is a very strong form line when resuming she drops in class & weight with Bella Youngberry's 3kg claim. Expect to see her roll forward & land a prominent spot from the outset. Kingdom Undersiege will strip fitter & appreciate 1200m, worked home well first up over 1000m just didn't have the dash though. Addriel in the mix also.

bestBets.overview: 1350m C2. A dozen can run but won't. No's 1,8,12,13,17 could be the pace. Jack Bruce was potentially good for four,  two remain. Team Munce potentially had two running, now one. Matthew Hoysted likewise. Ironically I could see myself making a case for SOCIABLE once them known unknowns became known and despite gate one this too is now out. raceTips.comment: No shortage of scratchings in this final race. Global Eclipse another having run number one for the new yard, has raced well fresh in the past & the early support has been there.
